acceptanceCriteria: A replay over PRs #210-#223 shows which pairs the overlap report would have separated, compared with the conflicts that actually occurred.
A spec or decision records the advisory output shape before any workflow ships.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner's request to research Corvint integrations with large productivity gains. `corvint review` already reports local branch overlaps. Applied to PRs waiting in a GitHub merge queue (merge_group event) or Mergify, overlapping PRs could be separated into different batches and independent ones grouped, reducing queue ejections. Output is an advisory label or check summary, never a gate. Related: V1-0332 (append conflicts in docs files). Any productivity gain is a hypothesis until measured; `corvint surprise` and `corvint necessity` supply the measure.
title: ci: advisory merge-queue ordering from cross-PR impact overlap
